tasks.label: Install supOS
tasks.command: docker run -d --name supos-bedrock --restart always -p 8080:8080 -v /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock -v /volumes/supos/data:/volumes/supos/data -e HOST_IPS="$(hostname -I)" leekaize/supos-bedrock:latest

tasks.label: Uninstall supOS
tasks.command: docker stop supos-bedrock && docker rm supos-bedrock && bash ${workspaceFolder}/bin/clean-all.sh
